scope: Partial implementation/runtime evidence: web release packaging compares every JavaScript lockfile package name, version and license with THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.json, rejecting missing, extra, stale-version and stale-license entries before building. Full redistribution terms, complete license texts/assets and model attribution remain open; K09 is not complete.
environment: Node 24.14.0; npm 11.9.0; local production web packaging
regression: Before implementation, the stale-version test failed: the web artifact was produced despite the inventory version mismatch (14/15 focused tests passed). After implementation, node --test tests/release-packaging.test.ts passed 15/15, including version, license, missing and extra inventory drift. The real production web target packaged successfully with all 1052 lockfile inventory entries matching.
